en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined riverside path. On the left is a dirt walkway bordered by regularly spaced trees; on the right a calm river runs past several multi‑storey buildings. The image has a tranquil, small‑town atmosphere. In the lower left corner the caption identifies the location, and in the lower right corner there is a small printer's or publisher's logo with a year.
